---
name: Pull request
about: Provide a template for your pull request
---

## Description

Briefly describe the changes made in this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes, just code improvement)
- [ ] Tests (adding or updating tests)
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Related Issue

Fixes #(issue number)
Closes #(issue number)
Related to #(issue number)

## Changes Made

List the main changes made:

- Changed X to do Y
- Added Z feature
- Fixed bug in module

## Testing

Describe how you tested your changes:

- [ ] Added/updated unit tests
- [ ] Added/updated integration tests
- [ ] Manually tested the following scenarios:
  - Scenario 1
  - Scenario 2
- [ ] All tests pass locally: `pnpm test`

## Screenshots (if applicable)

If this is a UI change, include screenshots of the changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm format`)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (if needed)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings (run `pnpm typecheck`)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have run `pnpm changeset` (if applicable)

## Additional Notes

Any additional information or context you think is important for reviewers to know.
